reason: The README describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is converting chat images into OCR text and vision-model descriptions so text-only language models can process them, using configurable local or external backends.

summaries.zh: 将聊天中的图片转换为 OCR 文本和视觉模型描述，帮助纯文本模型理解截图、文档、照片和图表。
summaries.en: Converts chat images into OCR text and vision-model descriptions so text-only language models can process screenshots, documents, photos, and diagrams.

capabilities: Intercepts image blocks in LLM requests
Performs OCR on images using local or HTTP engines
Sends images to configured vision-model backends for descriptions
Supports multiple external and local vision providers with fallback
Caches converted image text across sessions
Reads configured model credentials through the host credentials service
